title: Use Seedance 2.5’s “draw camera path on the image” feature to control camera…
content: Use Seedance 2.5’s “draw camera path on the image” feature to control camera movement directly instead of describing every movement in text prompts.
tips: Use Seedance 2.5’s “draw camera path on the image” feature to control camera movement directly instead of describing every movement in text prompts.

es.content: Usa la función “draw camera path on the image” de Seedance 2.5 para controlar el movimiento de la cámara directamente, en lugar de describir cada movimiento en prompts de texto.

fr.content: Utilisez la fonctionnalité « draw camera path on the image » de Seedance 2.5 pour contrôler directement le mouvement de la caméra, au lieu de décrire chaque mouvement dans des prompts textuels.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5 の「draw camera path on the image」機能を使えば、テキストプロンプトで一つひとつ動きを説明する代わりに、カメラの動きを直接コントロールできます。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5의 “draw camera path on the image” 기능을 사용하면, 텍스트 프롬프트로 모든 움직임을 일일이 설명하는 대신 카메라 움직임을 직접 제어할 수 있습니다.

pt.content: Use o recurso “draw camera path on the image” do Seedance 2.5 para controlar o movimento da câmera diretamente, em vez de descrever cada movimento em prompts de texto.

zh.content: 使用 Seedance 2.5 的“在图像上绘制相机路径”功能，直接控制镜头运动，而不是在文本 prompt 中逐一描述每个动作。
